<function name="Skip" parent="File" type="classfunc">
	<description>Moves the file pointer by the specified amount of chars.</description>
	<realm>Shared and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="amount" type="number">The amount of chars to skip, can be negative to skip backwards.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">amount</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
